overview.text: OneSource presents blockchain-data access through a REST API, a local MCP server and custom Flex builds. REST and MCP are described as direct chain reads; Flex combines off-chain and on-chain data with custom schemas and Block Doctors validation. Listed self-service pricing is $20 a month for two million monthly requests with a 200,000 daily limit, or $0.001 to $0.010 per query via x402 with USDC on Base or MPP with pathUSD on Tempo. These are advertised access terms, not a final checkout total or an independent data-quality audit.
